blurb.bm: Menara ikonik George Town, betul-betul di sebelah kawasan warisan.
blurb.en: George Town’s landmark tower, right beside the heritage quarter.

why.bm: Ya! Sempena Tun Abdul Razak, Perdana Menteri kedua Malaysia.
why.en: Yes! Named after Tun Abdul Razak, Malaysia’s second Prime Minister.

intro.bm: KOMTAR (Kompleks Tun Abdul Razak) ialah kompleks pentadbiran dan beli-belah di tengah George Town.
intro.en: KOMTAR (Kompleks Tun Abdul Razak) is a civic and shopping complex in the heart of George Town.

bm: Menaranya setinggi kira-kira 249 meter, dengan 68 tingkat.
Ia bangunan tertinggi di Malaysia sehingga 1988, apabila Menara Maybank mengatasinya.
en: Its tower is about 249 metres tall, with 68 floors.
It was Malaysia’s tallest building until 1988, when Maybank Tower overtook it.

bm: Pemandangan bandar lama dan baru dari tingkat atas
Rumah kedai lama di sekeliling kaki menara
en: Views of the old and new city from the top
Old shophouses around the foot of the tower

fun.bm: Sehingga November 1986, ia juga bangunan tertinggi di Asia Tenggara.
fun.en: Until November 1986 it was also the tallest building in Southeast Asia.
